answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing sparse nutrients, decentralized consensus binds agents through an interconnected trust graph. Pure computational weight is conductive like copper, yet synthetic identities lack the organic thread of historical interaction. By enforcing recursive collateralized attestations, sybil creation incurs superlinear attacker cost: forging an ivory facade of thousands of colluding clones demands exponential stake commitments across the network mesh, starving malicious swarms before their artificial blooms can root.
